name: Suzuki GSX-R750
engine: 749 cc liquid-cooled DOHC inline four (carbs on early bikes, fuel injected later)
intro: Suzuki's long-running 750. Check the brake master cylinder and chain adjuster recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2004-2013 GSX-R750s are in recall 13V449 (front brake master cylinder). 2011-2014 bikes are in recall 14V629 (chain adjuster).
A-002.reason: Both are safety recalls and the fixes are free.

G: Early bikes have carbs and later ones are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.
K: Old brake fluid is what makes the master cylinder piston corrode. Change it on schedule.

recalls.what: With old brake fluid, the front brake master cylinder piston can corrode and give a soft brake.
After a missed upshift, the chain strain can move the rear axle and the chain may come off.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits an improved left chain adjuster free.
